recommendations.title: Refresh: Add a regional payback summary (SE1–SE4)
recommendations.details: Add a short section or sidebar to the existing payback/guide pages that presents expected payback ranges for each Swedish electricity price region (SE1–SE4) and for 3 common system sizes (e.g., 3, 7, 10 kWp). Include the key assumption values used for each region (kWh/kWp, spot price used, and a typical price per kWp band). This gives quick, region-specific guidance without recalculating. Keep it visual and easy to scan.

suggestedSections: Antaganden som ligger bakom tabellen (kWh/kWp, elpris, egenanvändning)

recommendations.title: Create: Interactive payback calculator embed or guided example
recommendations.details: Develop or embed an interactive calculator on the payback guide page that lets users enter system size, nettopris per kWp (or total nettopris), expected self-consumption (%), and region to get an immediate payback estimate and a downloadable PDF of assumptions. Show how changes in each input affect payback (sensitivity) and include inverter replacement cost as an optional input.

recommendations.details: Add a compact assumptions table and a short worked example showing the effect of an inverter replacement (timing and cost) on payback. Quantify a typical inverter cost and show a before/after payback example with replacement at year 10–15 to make long-term economics clearer.
